comparison.objective: Extract one connector terminal by releasing its locking tab, versus isolate a battery pack and remove busbars.
comparison.physical_skill: Recessed single-blade tab release with coordinated wire/tool pull, versus plug removal and collision-safe busbar transport.
comparison.success_condition: Selected terminal out with housing, crimp, and neighbors intact; versus service plug out and busbars resting in a tray without hazardous movement.
comparison.reason: The record tests electrical-isolation sequencing and large-part handling, not terminal-lock release.
